args.code: (() => { try { const save = localStorage.getItem("farm_game_save_v1"); const data = JSON.parse(save); const skills = data.skills || {}; const skillSummary = {}; for (const k in skills) { const v = skills[k]; skillSummary[k] = typeof v === "number" ? v : (v.level || v.value || JSON.stringify(v)); } const npcFriends = data.npcFriendship || {}; const npcSummary = []; for (const k in npcFriends) { npcSummary.push(k + ":" + npcFriends[k]); } npcSummary.sort((a,b) => { const av = parseInt(a.split(":")[1]); const bv = parseInt(b.split(":")[1]); return bv - av; }); const events = data.eventHistory || []; const eventTypes = {}; events.forEach(e => { const t = e.type || e.name || "unknown"; eventTypes[t] = (eventTypes[t] || 0) + 1; }); const fields = data.fields || []; const fieldSummary = []; fields.forEach(f => { fieldSummary.push("田" + f.id + ":" + (f.crop || "空") + "(" + (f.stage || "") + ")"); }); return JSON.stringify({skills: skillSummary, npcSummary: npcSummary, npcCount: npcSummary.length, eventCount: events.length, eventTypes: eventTypes, fieldSummary: fieldSummary, daysPlayed: data.daysPlayed, totalHarvest: data.totalHarvested, totalSold: data.totalSold, unlockedFeatures: data.unlockedFeatures, milestones: data.unlockedMilestones, tasks: data.activeTasks, mode: data.mode, tutorialStep: data.tutorialStep, currentEvent: data.currentEvent, disasterRate: data.disasterRate, gameSpeed: data.gameSpeed, research: data.researchPoints, storage: data.storageCapacity, reputation: data.reputation, mood: data.mood, money: data.money, day: data.day, season: data.season, weather: data.currentWeather, stamina: data.stamina, maxStamina: data.maxStamina, health: data.health, maxHealth: data.maxHealth, fields: fields.length, pets: data.pets, inventory: data.inventory}); } catch(e) { return JSON.stringify({error: e.message}); } })()
